plugins.Author: erdelf, Herculezz
plugins.Name: AutoDuty
plugins.Punchline: Dungeons while you sleep, eat, or work. (Swimsuit Shtola made easy.)
plugins.Description: A plugin to run dungeons for you with Trust, Duty Support, Squadrons, Variants, and Regular, Requires BossMod, vnavmesh and a Rotation Plugin (BossMod AutoRotation, Wrath or RotationSolverReborn)
plugins.Changelog:
## What's Changed
* Crucible using Reraiser and Temporal Sands by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/544
* Stop Path advancing if not ready by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/544
* Writing ilvl in MainTab duty selection by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/544
* Shoplist update by @learn2draw in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/543
* Crucible: Disabling Death Helper (mostly) by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/546
* Adjusting Overlay Info Hovers by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/547
* Boss Detection Tweak by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/548 and https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/549
* Crucible fix feeding stall by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/550
* Crucible Shop Priority in Duty & Colored by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/551
* Crucible: adjusting shop orders and migration by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/552
* Crucible Shop Priority table tweaks by @erdelf in https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/pull/553

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/erdelf/AutoDuty/compare/0.0.0.368...0.0.0.369
